random_structure_columns.name: Random Structures — Cylinder Field
random_structure_columns.description: A 10 by 10 cylinder field adapted from Palle's Rhino example. Retained draws control height, radius or both while every base stays on the grid. BASELINE, RANGE, SEED +1, TARGET, KEEP and REPLAY expose the assignment and preserve it.
random_structure_columns.qfep_connection: A regular address system stays while chosen dimensions vary. The experiment can revise which property receives the draw rather than equating more variation with a better form.

random_structure_spheres.name: Random Structures — Raised Sphere Grid
random_structure_spheres.description: One hundred spheres keep their horizontal grid and radius while retained random values change their height. The overlapping surfaces echo the Rhino example; this is a mesh assembly, not a Boolean solid union. BASELINE, RANGE, SEED +1, RESET, KEEP and REPLAY support comparison.
random_structure_spheres.qfep_connection: The same grid becomes a spatial field when one coordinate is permitted to vary. Overlap exposes a separate choice about the relation between radius and spacing.

random_structure_lattice.name: Random Structures — Pipe Lattice
random_structure_lattice.description: Four 7 by 7 node levels retain 147 direct posts. Seeded threshold choices add connections to legal neighbours on the next level; a separate range displaces upper nodes. LINKS changes connection probability without moving the nodes. KEEP/REPLAY retains the draws and settings. This is geometry, not an engineered load-bearing structure.
random_structure_lattice.qfep_connection: A boundary decides which connections are admissible before chance chooses among them. Geometry and connectivity can be varied separately, making that boundary inspectable.

random_structure_tree.name: Random Structures — Branching Tree
random_structure_tree.description: A trunk divides into three, then nine, then twenty-seven tips. Forty branches retain their parent-child structure while seeded offsets vary the endpoints. Radius follows depth rather than the traversal counter. BASELINE, RANGE, SEED +1, RESET, KEEP and REPLAY compare the same branching rule.
random_structure_tree.qfep_connection: The rule fixes who may branch and how often; the draw changes where each branch arrives. Revising the branching rule would be a different intervention from changing its seed.
